_comment: Per-widget gzipped chunk caps in bytes. Task 47 / design §W-r3. Keys for widgets are the source filename (relative to apps/web/) of the lazy-imported widget module — check-bundle-size.mjs resolves these via Vite's build manifest. 'dashboard-entry' is the dashboard route's initial chunk (entry components + registry shells + gridstack + event-bus store + theme hook, EXCLUSIVE of lazy widget chunks). totalBundle was raised from 512000 (500 KiB) to 520192 (508 KiB) for the unrealised-P&L quote feature's ~5 KB of eager code (the shared quote feed hook, registry store and mark-to-market helpers, loaded on the dashboard open-positions widget, the drawer Open Positions tab and the position-detail page); the app has no route-level code-splitting, so that code rides the single entry chunk.
